# Capture compatibility fixture
+
+`coc2-request-capture-v2.json` is a real version-2 translator request capture
+from CoC2 0.9.6, translator 0.10.2, recorded on 2026-09-07. It contains 19
+request sets, with request inputs and settings but no API credentials or model
+responses. It is retained as an input-compatibility fixture for the current
+capture reader; it does not establish translation quality or current runtime
+readiness. Do not submit its inputs to any external service without a separately
+authorized task.
+
